postInstallation.note: Initial preflight below is retained as historical evidence. CLI tests do not prove Desktop behavior.

scope: Skill selection, delegation decisions, authorization boundaries and selected routing/collaboration follow-ups.

observations: Native spawn arguments and returned identity
Actual tool events and produced artifacts
No-spawn checks over the complete run
Relevant source locators and fixture assertions
not_evidence: Static route validator accepts a combination
Directory version label without matching contents
method.execution: Use separate fresh test sessions with the installed target version, necessary fixture only, no expected result in the task prompt. Do not create user-owned app threads without authorization. Record host/model/effort and role availability. Start with one run per case; this is functional acceptance, not a statistical trigger-rate estimate.
method.judgment: Mandatory no-delegation boundaries are hard assertions. Heuristic cases evaluate task-specific reason and actual action; keeping work local is not automatically a failure where rules only favor delegation.
method.limits: No builds, hardware, publication, real quota exhaustion or global policy edits. Test fixture policy applies only in isolated workspaces.

observed: Cached SKILL.md still uses quality OR elapsed-time benefit gate and four model-bound old roles.
Three new model-independent role files are missing or differ in native installation.
Four retired model-bound native role files remain.
preflight.consequence: Do not report old runtime behavior as target 3.0.0 acceptance.
